headline: Leads arrived on WhatsApp at 11pm and got an answer at 11am
leak: Most enquiries came in after work hours, and the first reply took most of a day.
sub: The team needed saved replies, a night rota for the first message, and a rule for handing a chat to sales.
steps: Reply time matched the lost leads.
Saved replies and a night rota.
miss: An automated greeting made replies faster and conversations worse. We cut it to one line.
